Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the overlapping free 30-min slots for both of them:

- Mon: 09:00-09:30 or 09:30-10:00
- Tue: 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 15:00-15:30 or 15:30-16:00
- Thu: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Fri: 11:00-11:30 or 11:30-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other) work for all four partners. I'll create the booking once we agree on a time.
